The '''Mev system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. The damaged [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Corrupter (Imperial-class)|''Corrupter'']] was stranded in the system waiting for repair parts. However, the [[Corrupter repair convoy|convoy]] carrying supply parts was attacked and destroyed by rebel forces in the [[Battle of Bettel]].
